title: Boss: one runbook, every distro
summary: Write the tooling that lets one runbook work across a mixed fleet.

steps.title: Portable runbooks
steps.body: Your runbooks are written for Ubuntu, but the fleet also has Rocky, Arch, openSUSE and Alpine. Build the translator, an upgrade report, and a firewall converter so one runbook works everywhere.

steps.title: Translate between any two package managers
prompt: Write `string Convert(string command, string target)` that converts a package command from **any** of `apt`, `dnf`, `zypper`, `pacman`, `apk` to `target` (same five), for these jobs:
| job | apt | dnf | zypper | pacman | apk |
Recognise the source by its first two words (after an optional `sudo`, which is kept). Package names after them are kept. Unrecognised → `"unsupported"`.
solution: var table = new Dictionary<string, Dictionary<string, string>>
hints: Store the full table once; find the job whose text equals the first two words.
Then look up the same job under `target`.
template: Dojo.Eq("apt to apk", "sudo apk add nginx", Convert("sudo apt install nginx", "apk"));
Dojo.Eq("pacman to dnf", "dnf remove vim", Convert("pacman -R vim", "dnf"));
Dojo.Eq("apk to zypper", "zypper update", Convert("apk upgrade", "zypper"));
Dojo.Eq("dnf to apt, two packages", "apt search jq yq", Convert("dnf search jq yq", "apt"));
Dojo.Eq("same tool", "apk del curl", Convert("apk del curl", "apk"));

steps.title: ufw to firewalld
prompt: Write `List<string> ToFirewalld(string[] ufwRules)` converting ufw commands into firewalld commands, then appending `firewall-cmd --reload` if any rule was converted:
- `ufw allow <port>` (digits only) → two lines: the tcp and then the udp version (ufw opens both)
- a leading `sudo` is dropped; anything else is skipped.
solution: if (w.Count == 2 && w[1] == "enable") { output.Add("systemctl enable --now firewalld"); continue; }
hints: Split each rule into words and drop `sudo`.
The last word decides: contains `/` → port, all digits → tcp and udp, otherwise a service.
Track whether anything changed to decide on `--reload`.
template: Dojo.Eq("a typical web server", new List<string> {
"firewall-cmd --reload" }, ToFirewalld(new[] { "sudo ufw allow ssh", "ufw allow 443/tcp", "ufw allow 8080", "ufw enable" }));
"firewall-cmd --reload" }, ToFirewalld(new[] { "ufw delete allow http", "ufw delete allow 53/udp", "ufw status" }));
Dojo.Eq("enable only needs no reload", new List<string> { "systemctl enable --now firewalld" }, ToFirewalld(new[] { "ufw enable" }));
Dojo.Eq("nothing to do", new List<string>(), ToFirewalld(new[] { "echo hi", "" }));
